name: Kaunas University of Applied Sciences
summary: Applied-sciences college in Kaunas with seven English-taught professional bachelor's in business, tourism, computing and nursing.

ib.text: Upload your IB diploma and results (50% average minimum); English needs IELTS 5.5 or equivalent, or the college's B2 test; a school letter on the language of instruction is not accepted. A test and interview follow.

programmes.name: International Business
programmes.about: Trains international business managers to analyse the business environment, work with foreign partners and customers, and plan international activities in a company or department.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: One reference and a motivation letter are required; a knowledge and skills test and motivation interview apply.

programmes.name: Sales and Marketing
programmes.about: Professional bachelor in sales and marketing with a key competence test and motivation interview for entry.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Tourism and Hotel Management
programmes.about: Three-year programme for people passionate about tourism, with international exchanges and hands-on experience; delivered in Lithuania for more than 20 years.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: One reference and a motivation letter are required.

programmes.name: English for Public Relations
programmes.about: Specialists who communicate in professional English, use management and public-communication terms, run internal and external communication and develop information products.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: One reference and a motivation letter are required.

programmes.name: Multimedia Technology
programmes.about: Specialists who assess the market for multimedia products, design and justify new product concepts, and develop multimedia products and systems.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: Software systems
programmes.about: Professionals who design, develop and install client/server, data engineering and internet-of-things software systems and solve software tasks in organisations.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

programmes.name: General Practice Nursing
programmes.about: Trains general practice nurses for care across settings and all ages, including healthy lifestyle support and evidence-based practice.
programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on your recalculated school grades (50% average minimum), a remote key competence test and a motivation interview, each weighted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.
programmes.ib: Documents may be in English or Lithuanian; key competence test and motivation interview apply.

notes: EU citizens can apply for a state-funded place through the national LAMA BPO joint admission; otherwise the college's own route applies, with a €120 application fee and the same fees for every nationality.

The 2026 list also showed Fashion Design, Oral Hygiene, Photography and Organization Management (Alytus) as English programmes not accepting applications, so they are left out until the college lists them.
Fees are fixed in the study agreement and paid for the whole first year in advance; 2026 prices are €2,750, €3,100, €3,510 and €4,680 depending on the programme.
